clips.title: The story
paras: Deathguard Linnea calls patrollers to defend Tirisfal Glades. She sends them after Riptear, an abomination roaming near Venomweb Vale that should never have passed the Bulwark.

The Bulwark is the sole fortified barrier between Tirisfal Glades and the horrors of the Western Plaguelands. Forsaken military strategy depends on fighting on one front. If mindless undead slip behind the lines, they can choke the supply routes feeding the front. Stray spirits or ghouls sometimes bypass the barricades, but an abomination roaming the glades signals a grave failure of containment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.
Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.
Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.
See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you dealt with our little problem?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.
Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.
